rows.title: The germinal products set's own consignment addresses page and its five party pickers, with no county parish holding number and no permanent address
rows.detail: A trader importing germinal products needs to record every party of the consignment inside the germinal notification, on a page that reads and behaves like the one live animals use. Germinal products are not kept on a holding and are not pets, so the germinal set is only ever asked for the five consignment addresses: it shows no county parish holding number section and no permanent address section, and serves neither page. This gives the germinal products set its own consignment addresses page and its own five party pickers, under the germinal set's own journey and routes, keeping the live-animal wording word for word.
acceptanceCriteria: For every germinal commodity, a germinal products notification's consignment addresses page shows exactly five sections, in this order: "Place of origin", "Consignor", "Consignee", "Importer", "Place of destination" (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

Nothing in the germinal products set links to a county parish holding number page or to a permanent address page, and a request for either page under a germinal products notification shows "Page not found" (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-059, repo-frontend-p14-061)

The germinal consignment addresses page shows the caption "Addresses", the heading "Consignment addresses" and the intro "Add all the addresses that are involved in the consignment." (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-001; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-010)

Each germinal section carries its hint word for word: Place of origin "The address where the animals begin their journey to Great Britain", Consignor "This is the sender of the consignment.", Consignee "This is the receiver or buyer of the consignment being shipped or transported.", Importer "This is usually the same as the consignee. You can select a different person if needed." and Place of destination "This is where the animals will be unloaded and accommodated for at least 48 hours. If a health certificate is required, it will show this address." (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122-m1)

Each germinal section with no address chosen shows its link — "Add a place of origin", "Add a consignor", "Add a consignee", "Add an importer", "Add a place of destination" — which opens the germinal set's own picker for that party; choosing an address there and saving returns to the germinal consignment addresses page, which shows that address's lines with a "Change" link, and the address is saved on that germinal products notification only (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-001, repo-frontend-p14-027)

Each germinal picker shows the caption "Addresses", a "Search" field hinted "Name, address or country" with a "Search" button, the results heading "Select an address", a count reading "Showing 2 out of 2 results" for two results, a table with the columns "Name", "Address" and "Country", a "View" link on each row, "Previous" and "Next" pagination, and "No addresses match your search." when a search matches nothing; and it lists only the addresses the address book holds for that party's role (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-013, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-027)

The germinal consignment addresses page shows "Same as place of origin" on an empty Consignor section once a place of origin has been chosen, and "Same as consignee" on an empty Importer section and an empty Place of destination section once a consignee has been chosen; pressing one copies that party's address into the section (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-001)

In Welsh, the germinal consignment addresses page and its five pickers show every section title, hint, link and picker label in Welsh, and both the page and the pickers have no serious or critical accessibility violations (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-058)
rows.notes: Re-drafted on this re-distil from existing row inc-181, which already covers these two requirements; neither changed in substance. Combines the two slices req-1826 (five sections only, no county parish holding number and no permanent address) and req-1827 (the germinal set's own copy of the page and the five pickers), because they are one page and one copy: building the copy without its section rule would show a county parish holding row the set cannot answer. c-091: the prototype wins on what germinal products are asked (no county parish holding number) and ruling sam-2026-10-09 decides how — germinal products become their own set, which leaves the page out, so the live-animals set keeps exempting only 0101 and 01061900. CARRY OVER: inc-181 also holds req-1832, req-1833 (cph-permanent-and-contact area) and req-1840 (notification-hub area) with their own criteria, including the germinal overview's addresses section and its single task row; the combiner keeps inc-181's id, its germinal-products theme, those requirements and its existing externalDependsOn on inc-091 (consignment-parties split) and inc-054 (identification-and-permanent-address split), merges this draft in and removes repeats. Ruling sam-2026-10-09-p1-014 copies each germinal page after its live twin is built, and the germinal-products theme already lands after the consignment-parties theme, so that order holds through the themes without a new dependency. The routes and form fields stay the service's own, with the live-animals slugs. Same behaviour in stub mode and on the compose stack, as for the live-animals pickers.

splitOff.why: It changes the overview's addresses section heading and its single task row's name, which live in the hub feature folder's copy and in the journey's task rows, and theme overview-and-review owns frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub.

It changes how a picker looks a stored selection up and which records a picker offers, and how an unreachable address book is reported, in frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/party-picker, plantsfrontend:src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features/address-book-picker and plantsfrontend:src/server/app/services/address-book, all of which theme consignment-parties owns.
